package.name: pinkrab_driver
package.description:
The servo bus, and nothing else. It reads both arms onto /joint_states, takes poses from /joint_commands_checked, and switches torque on and off through SetTorque and Estop.
The checked topic is the only one it subscribes to, so a gate that is not running is a robot that takes no new commands rather than one taking them unchecked. It knows nothing about teleop modes, handhelds or the studio: what reaches it has already been held against the joint bands, the scene and the ramp by pinkrab_safety, and a driver that also made those decisions would be hardware deciding policy.
